intro: Staff accounts for both municipalities. Create an admin, assign a municipality, create another super admin, or deactivate an account. The rules — you cannot change your own role, deactivate yourself or remove the last super admin — are enforced by the database and shown here when they refuse.

fields.municipalityNoneForSuper: A super admin belongs to no municipality and switches between them from the header.
fields.passwordHelp: Generated here. Hand it over in person or by a channel you trust; it is shown once and not stored.

create.title: New account
create.help: The person signs in with this email address and the initial password, and should change the password afterwards.

edit.title: Change {name}
edit.selfNote: Your own role cannot be changed from your own account. Another super admin can change it.

password.title: One-time password
password.body: This is the only time this password is shown. Hand it to {name} and ask them to change it after signing in.
password.done: Done — I have passed it on

deactivate.title: Deactivate this account?
deactivate.body: {name} will be refused at the next request and can no longer sign in. Everything they recorded stays, with their name on it.
deactivate.note: Deactivation is reversible. The last active super admin cannot be deactivated.
